corrected_text: LlmLiteRtCompiledModelExecutorBase creates its internal sampler once, in InitializeSampler on the first SampleLogits (or benchmark InitializeSampler) call, from the sampler parameters of the LlmContext loaded at that moment; InitializeSampler returns early when sampler_ exists, RestoreContext and UpdateRuntimeConfig don't reset sampler_, and no runtime code calls Sampler::UpdateConfig. So on the internal-sampler path, every step that goes through sampler_ (plain decode steps and MTP priming steps) samples with the parameters of the session that sampled first, for every session of the engine; tokens drafted and verified by MTP come from the drafter's own greedy samplers instead. v0.18.0's InitializeSampler has the same early return.
note: Spot audit after Run A (2026-10-15): the conclusion overreached for MTP sessions; drafted and verified tokens use the drafter's greedy k=1 samplers (llm_litert_mtp_drafter.cc:79-90, 401-411, 701); only plain and priming steps use sampler_ (executor Decode :1349, :1407).
